Building and bases

Practice building in the Sandbox, and save before leaving

Choose Sandbox in the server list or open it through Settings → System. Building and crafting cost no resources. Select structural materials directly and demolish pieces to adjust rooms and passages.

There are three save slots and no autosave. Save and load manually; declining to save on exit loses your changes. Saves stay on the device rather than syncing with your account, so consider this before reinstalling or switching phones.

This guide covers layouts and saves only. Official pages disagree about explosion damage testing, so we do not treat the Sandbox as a verified way to measure raid costs.
